description: target_end_position_deg: Target pose at end of successful lift-and-return (Y-button home from training recording). Used by eval_tracker.py for stage-3 (home-reached) detection. Arm-start-pose for eval is separately controlled by SO101_CFG.init_state + warmup_action in eval_session.py (matches recorder pattern). plateau_steps: per-stage max-stage-stuck timeout (60 Hz). Episode terminates if max_stage hasn't advanced for this many steps (only at stage >= 1). Current: 1_reach=2_lift=600 (10s); dict structure retained to allow per-stage differentiation in future (e.g. different budgets for slow vs fast transitions).
